recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future work-group decision changes how CapabilityStatement should advertise ActorDefinition or option support.
issue_request: FHIR-30587 was a Published FHIR-core change request with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested a usage note on CapabilityStatement.implementationGuide explaining that IG-level declaration is not sufficient to identify a supported actor or option and that IG-defined CapabilityStatements should be referenced through CapabilityStatement.instantiates to identify supported role(s).
initial_application: No local source-history commit labeled FHIR-30587 was found before this reconciliation. Commit dfb978d4cc307b814fb5a7a1680cad5c3bbcfb3e, although titled for FHIR-21452, added the exact FHIR-30587 usage note to source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml is in current build scope. FHIR-39433 later replaced the terse FHIR-30587 note with fuller wording explaining that implementationGuide asserts adherence to IG-level global definitions and general textual requirements but does not assert conformance to IG-defined CapabilityStatements; instantiates is required for those conformance claims. FHIR-42975 later resolved No Change because implementationGuide already is not the actor-specific mechanism, with ActorDefinition references handled separately by FHIR-43899.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope source already preserves and clarifies the FHIR-30587 distinction, so no additional source edit is needed.
